code: payload = fu_input_stream_read_bytes(stream, offset + hdrsz, payloadsz, error);
note: The uSWID header selects uncompressed data, so the input-controlled bytes after the header become the coSWID CBOR payload.

code: fw2 = fu_bytes_new_offset(payload, offset_tmp, payloadsz - offset_tmp, error);
note: The complete remaining input-controlled payload is wrapped as a GBytes object for the coSWID parser.
The coSWID payload bytes are decoded as a CBOR map containing an Entity map whose Role field is encoded as an unsigned integer.
The code recognizes the role value as an unsigned integer but lacks an else guard preventing the same non-array item from being processed by the following array loop.
cbor_array_size is called on the input-controlled unsigned-integer CBOR item instead of an array item, causing libcbor to read array metadata past the integer item allocation.
